newsSection.item1Title: International AI & Cybersecurity Conference Kicks Off
newsSection.item1Desc: The faculty hosts international researchers discussing deep learning and digital security advances.
newsSection.item2Title: Faculty Team Wins First Place in Arab Coding Hackathon
newsSection.item2Desc: Students developed an AI platform analyzing medical data using machine learning algorithms.
newsSection.item3Title: Applications Open for Postgraduate Programs for New Academic Year
newsSection.item3Desc: Postgraduate studies announce admissions for Master's and Ph.D. degrees in CS, IS, and IT.
newsSection.item4Title: Faculty Research Team Publishes New Data Science Study
newsSection.item4Desc: A faculty research team published a new study focused on practical data science applications.
newsSection.item1Content: The faculty welcomes researchers and students to a focused program of talks and discussions about recent developments in artificial intelligence and cybersecurity.
newsSection.item2Content: The student team represented the faculty in the Arab Coding Hackathon and achieved first place with an AI-based medical data analysis platform.
newsSection.item3Content: Applications are now open for the new academic year. Applicants can review the available postgraduate tracks and admission requirements.
newsSection.item4Content: The research team shared new findings that demonstrate practical uses of data science methods in real-world projects.
